lines.t: We serve each other in love, putting needs before our own.
We surrender our desires and will
Even our lives if He asks us to
We've learned what it truly means
To wash each other's feet
A right heart brings forth glad service
We give with joy and reap what we sow.
Life in abundance is our reward.
Our hearts sleep at the thought of washing the feet of the poor.
Whatever we do for another, we do as a gift to our King.
True devotion sees no difference
Between the greatest deed and the least
Every act is pure service
When love leads the way
A right heart brings forth glad service
United we choose the humble path
We trust with abandonment
We obey without expectation
We love without condition
Longing to know Him deeper still
Our faith moving ever forward
Mature and without fear
Blessed are we when we answer
Yes, we will serve
Our faith is revealed
Blessed are we when we pray
Your will be done, trusting entirely. Blessed are we who say amen in every moment and every season.
A right heart brings forth glad service
We give with joy and reap what we sow
Life in abundance is our reward
Our hearts leap at the thought
Of washing the feet of the poor
Whatever we do for another, we do as a gift to our King
The Spirit of unity leads us, we walk in His footsteps
Doing to others as we wish for ourselves
Every good done for another is an offering of love
Thank you for watching!
